en.title: Convert files to Markdown
en.description: Convert supported documents into Markdown for analysis, search, and retrieval workflows.
tasks: Convert supported documents into Markdown for analysis, search, and retrieval workflows.
prerequisites: Python 3.10+, uv, and MarkItDown with format-specific optional dependencies.
en.example: Use markitdown. Convert these local documents to Markdown, preserve source filenames, and report conversion failures.
en.expectedResult: Markdown files and a conversion log with source-to-output mapping.
limitations: OCR, URLs, audio, and cloud extraction may require additional services and credentials.

zh.title: 将文件转换为 Markdown
zh.description: 将支持的文档转为 Markdown，用于分析、搜索和检索流程。
tasks: 将支持的文档转为 Markdown，用于分析、搜索和检索流程。
prerequisites: Python 3.10+、uv、MarkItDown 及目标格式的可选依赖。
zh.example: 请使用 markitdown：把这些本地文档转成 Markdown，保留来源文件名并报告转换失败项。
zh.expectedResult: Markdown 文件与包含输入输出映射的转换日志。
limitations: OCR、网址、音频和云端提取可能需要额外服务与凭据。
